description: Set the main product image on EXISTING items by SKU (max 500 per call). Each row names an item (sku) and an absolute http(s) imageUrl on the scheme's default port; the server downloads the image (10 MB cap, must serve image/* from a public host) and sets it as the item's main image, REPLACING any current main image (the previous image stays in the gallery). Unknown SKUs report invalid — create items first with upsert_items, which also accepts imageUrl inline. validateOnly=true dry-runs every row without downloading. Partial success with per-row errors; resubmitting a landed row re-downloads and re-applies, so drop rows that already succeeded. Image downloading for the whole call is time-budgeted: once it is spent, the remaining rows fail with a budget-exceeded error — resubmit them in a smaller batch. A client-pinned credential targets its own client's items; an operator credential on a 3PL tenant passes clientId to name the target client.

clientId.description: Operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants: the target client id (GUID) the rows belong to — get ids from list_clients. Client-pinned credentials omit this; the credential decides.

images.description: Image rows (max 500). sku and imageUrl are required per row.

validateOnly.description: true = dry-run: validate every row and report would_set/invalid, downloading and writing nothing.
